summary: The buggy alias uses a byte-to-UTF-16 converter where a UTF-16-to-character converter is required, producing incorrect character indices for non-ASCII text. The actual fix converts the UTF-16 index to a byte index, then converts that byte index to a character index. The existing test checks a single frog emoji, whose UTF-16 endpoint 2 must map to character index 1. No tests were added by this commit. The reversal restores the exact parent implementation while preserving existing tests; reproduction has not been run.
